simple.summary: יְהֻד (Yᵉhud) means Jehud , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 19 45.

definitions.full: H3055. Yehud יְהֻד proper name, of a location in Dan , Josh 19:45 ; = modern Yehûdî yeh , 8 miles east of Joppa, and 11/2 hours [5 2-Janmiles] west of north from Lydda, Survey ii. 258 Guérin Judée i. 322 ; A Ιουθ , ᵐ5 L [Ι]ουδ (on form of name Jastr JBL xii, 1893, 61 ff. compare Ia-u-du , Tel el-Amarna No. 39 ).
